_comment: Single source of truth for the build pipeline. All paths are relative to this file's directory, which the scripts treat as the base path — campaign/ since the build moved into the repo (campaign/PLAN.md F5). Override the base with the FRAGILEPEACE_SUPPORT_DIR env var. Same contract as Caul's caul-support/site.config.json. No snapshot key: nothing in this campaign is dated by vintage, so no path uses one.
title: The Fragile Peace
_sources: Raw exports. The Archivist export is a snapshot and stops at session 39; sessions after that are hand-authored in repo_inputs.chronicle.
_site_root: The campaign owns campaign/ inside the VTT instance (campaign/PLAN.md M1). output_repo is the GIT root — factguard resolves old versions with `git show <ref>:<path>`, which is repo-root-relative — and site_root is where the generated pages are written and crawled beneath it. Empty means the repo root, as it was before the fork.
_repo_inputs: Hand-authored build inputs that live in the SITE REPO, relative to output_repo. They are versioned there on purpose: scripts/factguard.py proves a voice rewrite lost no facts by diffing each file against its committed version (git show <ref>:<path>), so this material needs git history. Moving it into this unversioned support folder would break that gate permanently.
_tools: doji-setsuna is a sibling generator, not a script: it builds its own standalone sheet and writes play/setsuna.html into the site repo, which the four other sheet builders then use as their template.
_external: Paths outside this campaign, centralised so a move is a one-line edit here. Titterpig moved from ~/Working to ~/Sortilege/Titterpig on 2026-09-13; these values were the only change needed.
